Recorded claim:
The xpcshell test calls browser.messengerUtilities.convertToPlainText from an extension background script, compares ordinary HTML line breaks and a long flowed case, then unloads the extension. The current test retains a named test_convertToPlainText task after the file rename. For text utility changes, assert actual API output, not only the underlying parser call; output formatting changed in the immediate follow-up after a debug assertion.
